findings.location: design.md section 4 and format-change-proposal.md section 8.2 (dos_time field in the envelope JSON sketch)
findings.problem: dos_time is shown as an ISO-8601 string, but a ZIP header stores a packed MS-DOS date/time (2-second resolution, 1980 epoch). As a representation this is fine, but the docs do not explicitly state that the recorded value is the exact MS-DOS field round-tripped losslessly rather than a re-derived wall-clock time.
findings.fix: Add a one-line note that dos_time encodes the raw MS-DOS date/time field (round-tripped to/from the packed bits), not a converted timestamp, so repack reproduces the original packed bytes. Covered in spirit by 'written verbatim'; the note removes ambiguity.
